about: Renewals desk (queue renewals-desk): templates for things that expire, so a person picks one, types its date once, and the estate warns, puts it in the calendar and rolls it forward when it is renewed. Each item: every (months between renewals, 0 = once), lead (days of warning), lapse (1 annoying, 2 a fine or a re-application, 3 lost cover, money or a credential), the steps, where to do it, and check (what to confirm on the official page, because sources disagree or a rule may change). cpe: credits needed per cycle. Paraphrased from public sources; never copied.

renewals.title: ISC2 annual fee (CISSP, CCSP and other ISC2 certifications)
renewals.dateHint: your certification anniversary, on the ISC2 member dashboard
renewals.cost: About US$135 a year. One fee covers all your ISC2 certifications.
steps: Open the ISC2 member dashboard and note the due date shown there.
Pay the annual fee before that date.
Keep the receipt with your papers.
renewals.check: The amount on your dashboard is the one that counts.

renewals.title: CISSP CPE cycle (120 in three years)
renewals.dateHint: the end of your three-year cycle, on the ISC2 member dashboard
renewals.cost: Free to report. Many CPE activities are free (webinars, reading, teaching, writing).

cpe.note: At least 90 of the 120 in Group A (security domains). 40 a year is the recommended pace.

steps: Log each activity the week you do it, with a line of proof.
Aim for about 10 a quarter.
Submit them on the dashboard; keep the proof for three years in case of an audit.
renewals.check: CCSP's cycle may differ from 2026; read your own requirement on the dashboard.

renewals.title: ISACA annual maintenance fee (CISM, CISA, CRISC)
renewals.cost: US$45 a year for ISACA members, US$85 for non-members; the invoice comes in the third quarter.
steps: Pay the invoice before 1 January.
Report at least 20 CPE hours for the year in the same visit.
renewals.check: ISACA's CPE policy changes from 1 January 2027: read it before planning the next cycle.

renewals.title: CISM CPE cycle (120 in three years, 20 each year)
renewals.dateHint: the end of your three-year reporting period, in MyISACA

cpe.note: At least 20 reported every year, 120 across the period. The same activity can often count for ISC2 and EC-Council too.

steps: Log each activity once; it counts towards every certification it is relevant to.
Report the year's hours before 31 December.
renewals.check: Confirm the yearly minimum on ISACA's page.

renewals.title: EC-Council membership and ECE credits (CEH)
renewals.dateHint: your certification anniversary, in the EC-Council member portal
renewals.cost: About US$80 a year; 120 ECE credits every three years.

cpe.note: ECE credits; activities logged for ISC2 or ISACA often count here too.

steps: Pay the annual fee in the member portal.
Upload the year's ECE credits from your log.
renewals.check: The fee is not on EC-Council's public page; read it in the portal.

renewals.title: Exam voucher: book the exam before it expires
renewals.dateHint: the voucher's expiry, shown in your account with the exam body
renewals.cost: The voucher's full price is lost if it expires.
steps: Find the voucher's expiry date in your account.
Pick an exam date at least three weeks before it, and book the test centre or online slot today.
Block study time in the calendar, working back from the exam.
renewals.portal: the exam body's account, then its test provider
renewals.check: Expiry dates are usually not extended; confirm with the exam body.

renewals.title: Pollution under control (PUC) certificate
renewals.dateHint: the expiry printed on the certificate
renewals.cost: A small fee at an authorised centre; a fine without it, and some cities refuse fuel.
steps: Drive to an authorised PUC centre (most fuel stations have one).
Check the details on the Parivahan site after the test.
renewals.check: Twelve months for BS-IV and BS-VI vehicles today; a 2026 draft proposes three years for BS-VI cars under six years old. Confirm before relying on it.

renewals.title: Vehicle insurance
renewals.cost: Driving without valid third-party cover is an offence; a gap can cost the no-claim bonus and needs an inspection.
steps: Compare the renewal quote with two others a month ahead.
Renew before the end date; do not count on a grace period.
Save the new policy in your papers.
renewals.check: Read your policy's own wording for any grace period.

renewals.title: Health insurance
renewals.cost: If it lapses, waiting periods for existing illnesses can start again. A claim during the grace days may not be covered.
steps: Check the sum insured still fits the family; raise it at renewal if not.
Pay before the end date (annual policies have a 30-day grace period, but cover in the gap is not assured).
Update the nominee and members if the family changed.
renewals.check: The grace period and cover in it are in your policy wording.

renewals.title: Life or term insurance premium
renewals.dateHint: the premium due date on the policy
renewals.cost: A lapsed policy can need medical tests to revive, or cannot be revived at all.
steps: Set the premium on auto-debit if you can.
Pay before the due date.
Check the nominee is current.
renewals.check: The grace period depends on the payment mode; it is in your policy.

renewals.title: Driving licence
renewals.dateHint: the 'valid till' date on the licence
renewals.cost: Driving on an expired licence is an offence; a long lapse can mean a fresh test.
steps: Apply on the Sarathi portal before the date.
Over 40, add a medical certificate (Form 1A).
Book the slot if your state asks for a visit.
renewals.check: The validity rules by age differ between sources and a change was proposed; trust the date on your licence.

renewals.title: Passport
renewals.dateHint: the expiry date on the passport
renewals.cost: Many countries refuse entry with less than six months left, so the real deadline is earlier than the date.
steps: Renew when about nine months are left.
Book the appointment on the passport portal.
Update visas and travel bookings with the new number.
renewals.portal: the passport portal of your country
renewals.check: Check the destination's own entry rule before any trip.
